caveat: Steady attrition rather than a cliff: 79% submit email, 71% account details, 63% business model, each step under a minute. Partners describe the problems starting after they are in (p14, p16), and this is consistent with that — the loss is downstream, not at the door.
demoted: Was HIGH. One source (a single PostHog funnel), and a seven-day window. Qual on why partners stall after signup would lift it.
source: PostHog saved funnel: Branded signup funnel prod, read live 2026-10-13
statement: Signup is not where partners are lost — 63% of 28,184 get through it to the business model step.
